answer: One defense is a work passport that cannot be bought or copied: each agent earns a non-transferable record only by completing real, paid jobs that counterparties verify, like a yarrow pressed into a ledger that grows one page at a time. New identities start with a tiny transaction cap, so a single opal of trust must be earned, not claimed. An attacker spawning fake agents faces the same wall at scale: every lotus of fake identity must first do real, costly work before it can move serious value, turning a cheap flood into an expensive trickle.
